verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo so the eyes and top of the face are cut off, which loses the 'looking up' idea, and the doodles are scattered without purpose. A is worse: the lightbulb doodle sits right on the mouth and teeth, and the question-mark doodle is jammed against the headline's '?'. B's lightbulb still overlaps the edge of the cheek, but its question mark sits clear to the left of the headline and the text block has more room.
